body.text: Three or four softly plucked gut strings on a small wooden early medieval lyre, a tiny relaxed modal phrase with natural pauses and warm woody resonance. One player nearby. No modern guitar strumming, piano, accompaniment, vocals, drums or background music. Let the last note decay naturally.
